notes: 4th Round obligation = 427 per court order May 19, 2025 (same as DCA). Present Need (rehab) = 4. 4th Round RDP = 4 units from one new site (299 Goffle Road, Block 2507 Lot 187.01, 1.62 ac, 13 du/ac, 20% set-aside). 4th Round Unmet Need = 423. Settlement with FSHC Dec 12, 2018; JOR September 2020. Compliance status is SETTLED — candidate snapshot had 'litigating' which is wrong. Three 4th Round RDP sites: The Enclave (1 credit), Ridgewood Dayton (7+1 bonus=8 credits), Two-Forty Associates (7 credits); total 16 credits vs. 4 RDP = 12 surplus credits. 4th Round unmet need strategies: Kensington Assisted Living (~12), Chestnut Street C-R-1 (25), Downtown B1&B2 increased to 20 du/ac/20% (313 total, 102 new 4th round), 299 Goffle Road (4 RDP units), Mandatory Set-Aside Ordinance (village-wide). Prior round unmet need strategies still active: Valley Hospital (Block 3301 Lot 51, 13 du/ac, min 40 family rental), AH-3 District (Block 4704 Lots 6.01, 7.04, 15), North Maple/Goffle B-3, mandatory set-aside.

sources.title: Village of Ridgewood 4th Round Adopted Housing Plan (adopted June 23, 2025)
sources.excerpt: Fourth Round RDP of 4 ... Block 2507, Lot 187.01 ... 1.62 ac ... density 13 ... court order May 19, 2025 ... Settlement with FSHC Dec 12, 2018 ... JOR September 2020

sites.quote: This development, located at 257 Ridgewood Avenue on Block 3703, Lots 4,6, and 8.01, redeveloped commercial uses. ... Thirty-two (32) market rate multi-family homes and eight (8) homes of special needs housing, consisting of not less than 15 bedrooms, exist on the site.
sites.notes: 32 market + 8 special needs group home bedrooms. 15 bedrooms total in special needs homes. 1 of 6 affordable credits applied to 4th Round RDP; remaining 5 applied to 3rd Round RDP. Constructed. Former Sealfons/Hallmark site. KS Broad site (Block 2005 Lots 11-15) also received set-aside via agreement with The Enclave.

sites.quote: This inclusionary zoning site was a vacant lot, formerly the site of Brogan Cadillac, located at Block 3707, Lot 5.01, and Block 3905, Lot 1.01. It consists of 2.67 acres at 100-152 South Broad Street, which intersects with Essex Street and Leroy Place. ... Seventy-nine (79) market rate multi-family rental homes and 14 affordable multi-family rental homes exist on the site.
sites.notes: 79 market + 14 affordable family rental = 93 total. 7 of 14 affordable credits applied to 4th Round RDP + 1 transit/redevelopment bonus credit = 8 credits. 7 of 14 applied to 3rd Round RDP. Former Brogan Cadillac site; eligible for bonus credit as former car dealership. Constructed.

sites.quote: This inclusionary zoning site is a 1.246 acre vacant parcel located at 150-174 Chestnut street, Block 2005, Lot 3, which intersects with Robinson Lane. ... Thirty-five (35) market rate multi-family rental homes and seven (7) affordable multi-family rental homes are constructed on the site for a total of forty-two (42) homes.
sites.notes: 35 market + 7 affordable family rental = 42 total. All 7 affordable credits applied to 4th Round RDP. Site plan approval April 4, 2017 (Resolution June 20, 2017). 30-year affordability controls. Near downtown/train station. Constructed.

sites.site_name: 299 Goffle Road — TO-1 Townhouse Overlay (4th Round RDP generation site)
sites.source_page: pp. 24, 28 (4th Round RDP Calculation / 299 Goffle Road sections)
sites.quote: 299 Goffle Road Block 2507, Lot 187.01 1.62 ac. 1.62 ac. 13 4.21 ... This 1.62 acre property is the subject of a new district, the TO-1 Townhouse Overlay district that predominantly permits townhouses.
sites.notes: 4th Round RDP generation site (oversized SFH lot now offered for inclusionary development). TO-1 Townhouse Overlay: 13 du/ac, 20% set-aside, townhouses/stacked townhouses/limited SFD. Generates 4.21 RDP units, rounded to 4. Also counts as 4 affordable units in 4th Round Unmet Need table. Proposed.

sites.site_name: Kensington Assisted Living (4th Round Unmet Need)
sites.address: Corners of North Maple, Franklin Avenue and Marshall Street
sites.quote: Kensington strategy applies to a 1.25 acre tract at the corners of North Maple, Franklin Avenue and Marshall Street (Block 3611, Lots 1, 19, 22). Office uses currently occupy the property and it is within the B-2 district, which permits mixed-use inclusionary development. ... The assisted living will restrict not less than 10% of the beds for low and moderate income households ... approximately 125 assisted living beds.
sites.notes: Unmet Need. ~125 assisted living beds; 10% affordable = approximately 12 affordable beds. Senior/age-restricted non-family rental. B-2 zone permits mixed-use inclusionary development. Proposed assisted living facility. 40-year affordability controls required.

sites.site_name: Chestnut Street C-R-1 Inclusionary District (4th Round Unmet Need)
sites.quote: The Village will create the C-R-1 district, which is a modified version of the adjacent C-R district to several properties along Chestnut Street totaling approximately 4.2 acres. This district will permit mixed use inclusionary development at a density of 30 du/ac and a set-aside of 20%.
sites.notes: Unmet Need (4th Round). New C-R-1 district on ~4.18 acres of Chestnut Street properties; 30 du/ac, 20% set-aside; anticipated 25 affordable homes. Includes 176 Chestnut Street (Block 2005 Lot 2). No individual block/lot listed in HEFSP for zone boundary.

sites.site_name: Downtown B1 & B2 Districts (modified, 4th Round Unmet Need)
sites.source_page: p. 28-29 (Downtown B1 & B2 Districts section) and Unmet Need table p. 29
sites.quote: The Village will modify this third round inclusionary strategy applying to 78.25 acres to better promote affordable housing. The permitted density will increase from 18 du/ac to 20 du/ac and the affordable housing set-aside will be 20% for rental and sale affordable homes (an increase from 15% for rental homes).
sites.notes: Unmet Need (4th Round). 78.25-acre B-1/B-2 downtown district; density increased from 18 to 20 du/ac; set-aside increased to 20% for rental (from 15%). 313 total anticipated affordable homes (211 attributable to 3rd Round; 102 new in 4th Round). Largest unmet need capacity.

sites.site_name: Valley Hospital Campus Redevelopment (3rd Round Unmet Need, ongoing)
sites.quote: A redevelopment plan was adopted for the site located at 223 North Van Dien Avenue, Block 3301 Lot 51, in the H zone. The redevelopment plan, which is an overlay to the H district, permits inclusionary housing at a density of 13 du/ac, with not less than 40 family rental affordable homes.
sites.notes: 3rd Round Unmet Need strategy carried into 4th Round. Hospital has vacated; medical uses remain during reuse/redevelopment. 13 du/ac; minimum 40 family rental affordable homes. No changes proposed; Village finds zoning remains appropriate. No units yielded to date.

sites.site_name: AH-3 District (3rd Round Unmet Need, ongoing)
sites.quote: This 5.40 acre area creates a new mixed-use Affordable Housing District along Ridge Road. The zoning in the district on Block 4704, Lots 6.01, 7.04, and 15 permits inclusionary housing at a graduated maximum density of 14-18 du/ac and an affordable housing set-aside of 15% where the homes are for rent and 20% where the homes are for sale.
sites.notes: 3rd Round Unmet Need, 5.40 acres; graduated density (14 du/ac for lots ≤0.50 ac, 16 for 0.51-1.25 ac, 18 for ≥1.26 ac); 15%/20% set-aside (rental/sale). No units yielded. Village finds zoning remains appropriate.
